home.title: Manage all your vacation homes in one place
home.subtitle: Add your properties, upload photos, and connect them to AirBnB, Booking, and other platforms.

meta.description: Portale Case Vacanze is the platform for vacation home owners: create your mini-site, manage your calendar and requests, link Airbnb and Booking. You always stay in control.

hero.title: Your vacation home. Your control.
hero.subtitle: Create your property's mini-site, manage the calendar and guest requests, link Airbnb and Booking — all from one place, with no middleman deciding for you.
hero.imageAlt: Photo of a vacation home published on the platform

valueProps.title: Not your typical property management tool
valueProps.subtitle: Most tools for vacation rentals are built for agencies and property managers, who run things on your behalf and keep control on their side. Here it's the other way around.

control.title: You keep control
control.description: No middleman between you and your data: sign in, edit and decide everything yourself, whenever you want.

ownSite.title: A mini-site that's yours
ownSite.description: Every property gets its own public page, with your style and your content — not buried inside someone else's platform.

noLockIn.title: No lock-in
noLockIn.description: You're free to stay on Airbnb, Booking and other platforms too: this is an extra channel, not a replacement.

features.title: Everything you need to manage a vacation home
features.subtitle: A tool built for the owner, from initial setup to day-to-day management.

wizard.title: Guided setup
wizard.description: A step-by-step wizard walks you through every detail: information, spaces, rules, area guide.

photos.title: Photo gallery
photos.description: Upload photos of your home, choose a cover, and show off your property at its best.

calendar.title: Availability calendar
calendar.description: Block unavailable periods and keep your real availability always up to date.

requests.title: Direct requests
requests.description: Receive availability requests directly from guests, with no booking commissions.

otaLinks.title: Platform links
otaLinks.description: Add links to your listings on Airbnb, Booking and other platforms, all reachable from your mini-site.

themes.title: Custom themes
themes.description: Choose from many visual themes to give your mini-site the style you want.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Publish notices visible to guests for ongoing work, check-in changes and more.

languages.title: Italian and English
languages.description: Interface available in two languages, for you and your international guests.

showcase.title: Already live
showcase.subtitle: Some of the vacation homes published on the platform.

cta.subtitle: Sign up for free and start setting up your property in minutes.
